answer: A smaller mechanism beats a bigger one here, so attach trust to the task rather than the address. Escrow releases when the panel agrees, and disagreement dilutes each peer's weight instead of forcing a full re-vote, which costs the farm time and the honest agent a retry. Two accounts on one task both get graded, and neither inherits the other's reputation. So a trellis of clones shares cost but not standing, and the lotus of inherited reputation never opens at the haven.
